title: Boden's mate

steps.text: Black has castled on the queen's side. Your bishop on f4 already takes b8 and c7, and the black king's own pieces stand on d7 and d8.
Your other bishop could check from a6. Tap the black pawn that blocks that diagonal.
steps.hint: Follow the diagonal from a6 to the king.
steps.after: That pawn guards the king. Pull it away, and the diagonal opens.

steps.text: Give the queen: capture the knight on c6, with check. The pawn must take back.
steps.hint: The queen takes on the long diagonal next to the king.
steps.after: The pawn took the queen and left its post in front of the king.

steps.hint: The bishop goes to the edge of the board on the open diagonal.
steps.after: Boden's mate. The two bishops cross in front of the king, and its own pieces block the rest.

summary: Two bishops on crossing diagonals mate a castled king whose own pieces block its side. A queen given up can open a line.
